integrity: The proof is analytic. The bundled standard-library computation is a finite-parameter sanity check and is not used as an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: The optimal universal constant remains between \(2/\sqrt{3}\) and \(2\). The lower-bound family uses increasingly inhomogeneous positive edge weights; no claim is made for uniformly weighted or doubling subclasses.
title: A \(2/\sqrt{3}\) lower bound for the universal edge-Riesz endpoint constant
